scope: Four focused GNC1 physical/GNC2 translated-image binned host controls for signed D32F polygon offset
coverage: GNC1 physical images and GNC2 translated images each exercise local/global two-CU payload profiles, two frames per profile, eight frames and sixteen native triangle draws in total.
GPU-memory GND1 window records retain signed factor/units through bin storage and replay. GFS1 state supplies versions3/4, centroid masks5/3 and blending.

2x/version3 frames check biased default D32F sample depth; 4x/version4 frames check a shader depth override bypassing the bias while shader fragCoord.z still affects MRT red. The two draws use opposite coefficient signs.

The scalar oracle evaluates depth at absolute sample positions and applies extended bias before FP32 packing. All four MRT source/resolve formats, D32F backing/sample-zero resolve, row padding and image guards match.
Fresh vertex/program allocations, GPU-memory bin/state fetches, prewarmed cached consumers, uniform tails, held-completion VM protection and drained reservations pass.
limitations: Four focused checks do not replace the full legacy/fault/reset and combined-source regression on new polygon hardware.
W=1 triangle frames with D32F do not qualify every depth format, primitive combination, clipping/perspective precision or raster minimum-resolvable difference.
No new emission/PPA, power, route, frame rate, complete Mobile budget or H0-H8 closure; PPA remains synthesis only.
